sn9.13:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ sambahulā bhikkhū Kosalesu viharanti aññatarasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe uddhatā uṇṇaḷā capalā mukharā vikiṇṇavācā muṭṭhassatino asampajānā asamāhitā vibbhantacittā pākatindriyā || || 2.
sn9.13:1.2: Atha kho yā tasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe adhivatthā devatā tesam bhikkhūnaṃ anukampikā atthakāmā te bhikkhū saṃvejetukāmā yena te bhikkhū ten-upasaṅkami || || 3. Upasaṅkamitvā te bhikkhū gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn9.13:6.1: Atha kho te bhikkhū tāya devatāya saṃvejitā saṃvegam āpādun ti || || 1.
